subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

If you want to be a good detective, it helps to have an __inquisitive__ nature.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Disinterested**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"inquisitive"** means having or showing an interest in learning things; curious. (जिज्ञासु)

 
 
• **Example: **Her inquisitive nature made her a great scientist, always eager to discover new things.
 
 
 
• **"Disinterested" **refers to having no personal interest or involvement; impartial. (निष्पक्ष)
 
 
• **Example: **As a judge, it is important to remain disinterested and impartial.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'inquisitive' **is **'disinterested'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Disinterested**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Comprehensive **(व्यापक): Including or dealing with all or nearly all elements or aspects of something.

 
 
• **Example:** The report was comprehensive, covering all the major aspects of the project.
 
 
 
• **Itemised **(सूचीबद्ध): Presenting as a list of individual items.
 
 
• **Example: **The invoice was itemised, detailing every single expense.
 
 
 
• **Intrusive** (आक्रामक): Causing disruption or annoyance through being unwelcome or uninvited.
 
 
• **Example:** His intrusive questions made everyone uncomfortable.
